vignette: A 35-year-old woman has a drooping right eyelid that is only 1–2 mm lower than the left, a right pupil that is smaller than the left, and the difference is greater when the lights are dimmed. She has had right-sided neck pain since a yoga class two days ago.
stem: What is the most important next step?

options.text: MRI of the brain for a pituitary tumor
CT angiography of the neck for carotid dissection
Chest X-ray for an apical tumor

explanation: A Horner syndrome (anisocoria greater in the dark, mild ptosis) with new neck pain is an internal carotid dissection until proven otherwise; the sympathetic plexus runs on the carotid wall. Vessel imaging of the neck is urgent because of the stroke risk.
